archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Modified for High-Contrast Utility

tablet_first_rules.touch_targets: MINIMUM 48px height (h-12 or h-14) for ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns).
tablet_first_rules.scrolling: ABSOLUTELY NO horizontal scrolling tables for data entry. Convert all 6-12 column data entry tables into Vertical Card-based Forms (Bento-style or stacked lists).
tablet_first_rules.contrast: Kitchens are bright. Use high contrast. Text must be Slate-900 on White surfaces. Do not use light grey text for important data.
tablet_first_rules.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (duotone or bold) at large sizes (w-6 h-6 to w-8 h-8) to make identification instant for chefs.

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (Control Room). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Avoid 4-column density on tablets.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 inside cards. No cramped p-4.
layout_and_spacing.filter_bar: Do not cram 5 columns. Use a horizontal scrollable chip row OR a 'Filters' button that opens a large Shadcn Sheet/Dialog.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Neumorphism/Tactile Variant for cards. Flat white backgrounds with sharp 1px border-stone-200 and a soft shadow-sm. Add a 4px left-border of primary red for active/overdue items.

components_strategy.inputs: Override Shadcn Input/Select/Dropdown to have `h-14` and `text-lg`. Use large tap areas.
components_strategy.buttons: Override Shadcn Button to have `size='lg'` as default (`h-14 px-8 text-lg font-semibold`).
components_strategy.tabs: Override Shadcn TabsList to be `h-14` or `h-16`, allowing text-lg and large tap targets. Avoid desktop-style tiny tabs.
components_strategy.record_entry_cards: For daily compliance forms, use a dynamic card layout. e.g., A card for 'Chicken Temp'. Date/Time row 1, Item Select row 2, Temp Input row 3. Much easier to tap than a wide table row.
components_strategy.quick_add: Floating Action Bar or top-pinned grid of large 'Quick Add' buttons for the 8 templates.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Kebab-case, role-based.

auth_background.description: Indian food spices top view, use as an atmospheric login/auth background with a heavy white/red gradient overlay.

empty_state_bg.description: Clean modern kitchen, use as an empty state background with 10% opacity or heavy blur.

instructions_to_main_agent: PHASE 1 - ARCHITECTURE: Break down the monolithic 1136-line component. Create separate components: DashboardView, RecordListView, RecordEntryForm, and TemplateManager.

PHASE 2 - TABLET SIZING: Globally override Shadcn inputs, selects, and buttons to h-14 with text-lg. Kitchen touch targets must be massive. Replace standard table filters with a full-screen mobile-style filter Sheet or horizontal scrolling pill-tabs.

PHASE 3 - DATA ENTRY OVERHAUL: Destroy the horizontal scrolling tables for Record Entry. Build a 'RecordEntryCard' component. If a template has 6 columns, render them as a 2x3 grid inside a large padded card. The chef should scroll vertically through cards, not horizontally through columns.

PHASE 4 - VISUAL DISTINCTION: Assign a specific Lucide React or Phosphor icon to each of the 8 templates (e.g., Thermometer for Temp Record, Sparkles for Cleaning). Display these prominently on the Dashboard and Quick Add buttons.
PHASE 5 - BRANDING: Inject the Purnabramha Deep Red (#8B0000) into primary buttons, active tab borders, and selected states. Ensure text contrast against this red is absolute white.
INSTALLATION: Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` for high-end duotone icons to replace standard lucide if preferred, otherwise use bold lucide-react.
